title: s&box is now an open-source game engine, and it’s built on Valve’s Source 2 and modern .NET

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Essenbox is now an open- source game engine and it's built on Valve's Source 2 and Modern.NET. You can create your own games in modern C with a super clean editor, instant play testing, and blazing fast hotloading. No compiling, no restarts. It even has visual scripting with action graph, shader graph, and a massive cloud asset library you can drag straight into your scene.
